name: WNBA_R3A6A_2019_H2H_SOURCE_CUSTODY_CONTRACT_V1
purpose: Certify the 2019 WNBA game-level source needed to give 2020 H2H targets the same target-season-plus-immediately-prior-season horizon used for later target seasons. This gate performs no R3 H2H model evaluation.
audit_questions: Does the downloaded asset reproduce the frozen byte size and SHA-256 exactly?
Are all allowlisted H2H identity/result columns present?
How many 2019 season_type=2 game IDs exist before special-event classification?
Does every candidate game have exactly two reciprocal team rows, exactly one HOME and one AWAY, a coherent official date, and reciprocal scores?
Which season_type=2 game IDs involve team identities outside the franchise team-ID universe observed in the remaining 2019 season_type=2 fixtures?
Is there a small objectively identifiable special-event set that must be frozen before constructing the two-season H2H prefix?

special_event_rule_in_this_gate.reason: R3A6A is discovery/custody only. It may report anomalous season_type=2 identities and game IDs, but the exact exclusion list must be frozen in a subsequent constructor contract before H2H features are built.
